BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or fails validation; `fields` names the offending fields, never their values.

Conflict.description: A conflict: duplicate, last administrator, or a concurrent change that survived the retries.

Forbidden.description: The caller's role does not allow this (decided by the use case).

NotFound.description: Not found - also what an id of another association gets.

RuleViolation.description: A business rule refuses it; `message` says which.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid access token (missing, expired, forged, or the account is no longer active).

bearerAuth.description: The short-lived access token of POST /auth/login or /auth/refresh.

info.description:
Session-by-session booking for amateur indoor volleyball associations. All paths are under /api/v1. The tenant
(association) and the caller always come from the bearer token, never from a path, query or body; an id that
belongs to another association answers exactly like an id that does not exist (404). Every failure has the body
described by ApiError. Times are ISO-8601 instants (UTC); weekly schedules and dates are Europe/Lisbon local time.
Money is in cents.
info.title: RegiVolley API
